title: pedicularis comosa subsp. campestris
intro: Pedicularis comosa subsp. campestris, commonly known as the Alpine Pedicle, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Orobanchaceae family and native to the mountainous regions of Europe. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Pedicularis comosa subsp. campestris include its expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
